{{Quote|No such thing as too young to stand up for what's right.|Mazi|<ref name="Hostage" />}}
'''Mazi''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The [[Standard day|day]] before Alderaan's [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], Mazi traveled to Alderaan's sister planet, [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]], with his brothers, [[Lan (Human)|Lan]] and [[Jez (Human)|Jez]], to watch a [[Smashball/Legends|smashball]] tournament. Following his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] destruction, Mazi and his siblings became [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] in order to survive on Delaya. They tried to rob [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] but were called off by [[Ferus Olin]], a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who threatened to stop giving them odd jobs if they continued thieving. When Organa was captured by a [[Alderaanian faction|faction]] that blamed her family for Alderaan's obliteration, Mazi revealed the faction's [[Unidentified school (Delaya)|hideout]] to Organa's [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] companions, allowing for her rescue. Afterward, the brothers decided to join the Rebel Alliance as [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].

==Biography==
===Early years===
{{Quote|There was a smashball tournament on Delaya. We got permission to go to the game, stay overnight on our own, then go back to Alderaan in the morning.''"<br />"''But that was the day&mdash;''"<br />"''Yeah. That was the day. So here we are. On our own.|Mazi and Han Solo, on Alderaan's destruction|<ref name="Hostage" />}}
Mazi was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Standard day|day]] before Alderaan's [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]<ref name="Hostage" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> Mazi went to see a [[Smashball/Legends|smashball]] tournament on Alderaan's sister planet, [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]], with his younger brothers, [[Lan (Human)|Lan]] and [[Jez (Human)|Jez]]. Despite the brothers' young age, Mazi was able to convince their [[Parent/Legends|parents]] to allow them to go.<ref name="Hostage" />

[[File:Alderaan.jpg|thumb|left|240px|Alderaan, Mazi's homeworld]]
After Alderaan's destruction, Mazi and his siblings survived on Delaya as [[Thief/Legends|thieves]]. Being the oldest of the three, Mazi acted as the leader of the group. [[Ferus Olin]], a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and another survivor of Alderaan, tried to dissuade them from turning to crime by giving them odd jobs to earn [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. When [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of Alderaan [[Mission to Delaya|visited]] Delaya to assist the [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] effort and recruit new members to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Mazi and his brothers attempted to rob her. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], one of Organa's companions, tried to placate the orphans, but the standoff was broken when Olin intervened and disarmed Mazi, who was holding Organa at [[Knife/Legends|knifepoint]] with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]. After Olin cautioned the orphans that he would stop giving them errands if they continued getting into trouble, the brothers retreated.<ref name="Hostage" />

The next day, a [[Memorial service on Delaya|memorial service]] was held in a [[Unidentified chamber (Delaya)|chamber]] within the city for those who had perished on Alderaan. Mazi and his siblings attended the event but could not get inside the building in which the memorial was held due to the large crowd. They were spotted by Solo who quickly grabbed Mazi into a hold, prompting Jez and Lan to come to his aid. Despite their fear, Jez and Lan stood their ground and demanded Solo let Mazi go. Impressed by the kids putting on a brave front, Solo released Mazi and befriended the brothers, offering [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and a chance to go inside the chamber. Their guard lowered, Mazi and his brothers told Solo how they came to be orphans on Delaya.<ref name="Hostage" />

===Helping the Rebel Alliance===
{{Quote|There's this place Halle and Kiro go when they want to be alone, this abandoned schoolhouse, a few blocks up the river. They think it's like this big romantic secret or something that they're together. Usually pretend they don't even know each other.''"<br />"''So how come you know?''"<br />"''I know a lot of stuff. It's easy to be invisible, when you want to be.|Mazi and Han Solo|<ref name="Hostage" />}}
When Organa was captured by a rogue Alderaanian [[Alderaanian faction|faction]] that blamed her for the destruction of their world, Mazi tracked down Organa's Rebel companions and provided them the location of the [[Unidentified school (Delaya)|hideout]] of [[Halle Dray]], one of the faction's ringleaders. The information proved invaluable as Solo and the others rescued Organa from the Empire, to whom she had been handed over by the faction in exchange for a new planet to settle on. Olin suspected that the orphans, who were willing to do anything for credits, in addition to knowing where Dray's hideout was, might have been hired by the faction to rob and capture Organa in their previous encounter.<ref name="Hostage" />

After Organa's rescue, Mazi and his brothers met with a Rebel recruiter and decided to enlist in the Alliance as [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. They excitedly informed Solo&mdash;whom they had grown quite fond of&mdash;of the news, aiming to impress him. Solo acknowledged that he was impressed, although he reflected that Mazi and his siblings were too young to serve in the Alliance. The orphans were scheduled to be shipped out that [[Local day/Legends|night]], and Solo wished them luck.<ref name="Hostage" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You ask me, we're better off forgetting the whole thing ever happened. We are from nowhere. Now.|Mazi to Jez, on forgetting their past|<ref name="Hostage" />}}
As a result of Alderaan's destruction, Mazi and his brothers became orphans overnight and had to look out for each other. Mazi became the unofficial leader due to his age, which Solo pegged to be around fifteen years, and Lan, being the youngest of the three, started looking up to Mazi with an admiring attitude akin to hero worship. Mazi enforced a strict rule among the orphans of forgetting everything about their past, claiming that they were from nowhere. Despite their predicament, Mazi and his siblings refused to be pitied by anyone. When Solo did not turn them in to the authorities for trying to rob Organa, the orphans began yearning to impress the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. Mazi had a pale facial complexion and a mop of greasy [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="Hostage" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Mazi can talk anyone into anything.|Lan, regarding Mazi|<ref name="Hostage" />}}
According to his brother Lan, Mazi had a talent of convincing people into agreeing with him. When he had the idea of going to Delaya to watch a smashball tournament with his brothers, Mazi was able to convince their parents to allow them to stay overnight on Delaya before returning to their homeworld the next day, in spite of their young age and their [[Lan's mother|mother's]] worries. After Alderaan was destroyed and the boys had to resort to thievery to survive, Mazi successfully used a wrist grabbing maneuver on Princess Organa and held her at knifepoint with his vibroblade. Han Solo considered the stunt worn-out, having done it a couple of times in his youth.<ref name="Hostage" />

==Equipment==
Mazi used a rusty vibroblade when robbing people on Delaya. He wore [[Clothing/Legends|pants]] with a back pocket, where he hid his vibroblade.<ref name="Hostage" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mazi was created by author [[Alex Wheeler]] for the [[2008]] novel ''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]'', the second volume in the ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'' series.<ref name="Hostage" />
